name: WordPress
description: Copy a document as clean WordPress blocks or classic-editor HTML, or publish it to your site as a draft or post.
author: Typora Team

siteUrl.title: Site
siteUrl.description: Your site's address. Publishing signs in with an Application Password (in WordPress: Users ▸ Profile ▸ Application Passwords). Only this site is contacted.

username.title: User name
username.description: Leave empty to be asked the first time you publish.

status.title: New posts are
status.description: A status in the front matter wins. Updating a post keeps its status.

uploadImages.title: Upload local images
uploadImages.description: Publishing uploads images stored on this computer to the Media Library and links the post to them.

removeTitleHeading.title: Leave the title heading out
removeTitleHeading.description: When the document starts with a # heading that is its title, the heading becomes the post title only, not part of the content.

classicParagraphs.title:
Keep

tags in classic HTML
classicParagraphs.description: Off: paragraphs are separated by blank lines, and the classic editor adds the tags itself.
